docs.text: summer in chicago is incredible for so many reasons, but one my favorites is going on daily lakeside walks. lake michigan is so pretty when the sun hits it. beyond words tbh.
Just seeing how this works. Oh, and Lake Michigan rocks in the summer.

New hot take: Summer + fall living along Lake Michigan (June to October) are the best! Winter (November to March) is neutral-to-slightly better. Spring (April to May) is WORSE due to chilly lake temps and constant winds. So overall, not sure it’s worth it 😩

It's not bad in early fall either! If you can tolerate things moving to winter hours, the days right after Labour Day are great. Still plenty of cherries. But summer does give more opportunities for jumping in Lake Michigan.
Our summer vacation this year is a spin around Lake Michigan (and peeks at Superior and Huron).
We have like 7-8 months of winter/cool weather here and I live on Lake Michigan with a beach in my back yard so I could go for a few more months of summer.
